purpose: Hero image concepts for the Embeddings article.

concepts.title: A mathematical Rosetta Stone
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landscape editorial hero illustration for a thoughtful technical blog article titled 'Embeddings — A Mathematical Rosetta Stone for Generative AI'. Generate a single finished hero image, approximately 16:9. The article explains how human language becomes high-dimensional numerical vectors, with semantic relationships encoded in geometry. Concept: an elegant sculptural stone tablet with a few subtle incised abstract writing marks on its surface, one edge gently resolving into an ordered field of tiny points and precise geometric vector lines. The transformation should feel like language revealing its underlying mathematical structure, a visual metaphor rather than a literal historical illustration. Pale warm limestone, tactile fine grain, charcoal and restrained cool blue geometric detail, warm off-white backdrop, soft museum-quality directional light, calm shadows and ample breathing room. Sophisticated contemporary editorial still life, exceptionally clean art direction, slightly elevated three-quarter view. One strong central composition readable at article-thumbnail size. No title, no readable words, no logos, no watermark, no people, no robots, no brain imagery, no busy interface or equations. Keep all essential imagery comfortably inside the frame for responsive crops.

concepts.title: Neighborhoods of meaning
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landscape editorial hero illustration for a technical blog article about embeddings and semantic similarity. Generate a single finished landscape image approximately 16:9. Article context: related concepts occupy nearby positions in high-dimensional vector space; the examples include milk, espresso, cappuccino and latte, savory foods such as burrito and hamburger, and family relationships. Concept: an exquisitely composed abstract atlas of meaning, an oblique view into a spacious dark graphite field containing three distinct constellations of fine points, with subtle local connections and a few floating, small, beautifully typeset word tokens. Clearly cluster 'milk', 'espresso', 'cappuccino', 'latte' together; a second cluster contains 'burrito', 'hamburger'; a third contains 'father', 'mother'. These are the only readable words, rendered correctly in restrained contemporary sans-serif typography. Give each cluster its own soft muted accent, blue-gray, amber, pale teal, with low saturation and no neon bloom. Quiet geometric depth cues, delicate fine lines, controlled light and a dark navy background compatible with an understated technical blog. The result should feel like a premium editorial illustration, not a dashboard or literal measured data visualization. Strong silhouette, intentional negative space, readable hierarchy, no title, no axes with fake numbers, no formulas, no logos, no watermark, no generic AI brains or robots. Keep the essential clusters and tokens comfortably inside the frame for responsive crops.

concepts.title: Vector arithmetic
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landscape editorial hero image for a technical blog article on embeddings. Generate a single landscape composition approximately 16:9. The article uses vector addition of the meanings of 'milk' and 'espresso' to find 'cappuccino'. Illustrate this as a restrained, clever editorial still life that combines coffee and geometry: a small glass of milk and a small espresso cup placed at the ends of two fine directional vectors; the vectors form a clean parallelogram construction on a subtly suggested plane, and their resultant reaches a beautifully crafted ceramic cappuccino cup with microfoam. Make the mathematics legible as a visual metaphor without labels, arithmetic symbols, axes, measurements or equations. Blend tactile photorealistic ceramics and liquid with precise thin graphite vector lines. Warm ivory paper-like background, rich espresso brown, milk white, quiet charcoal, very restrained pale blue geometric accent, soft natural studio shadows. Airy, refined magazine illustration with a slightly elevated camera and an asymmetric but balanced composition. The three objects and the vector relationship are the entire story. No people, no hands, no cafe decor, no text, no typography, no logo, no watermark. Readable at small hero-thumbnail size; objects and arrowheads should have breathing room from the edges for responsive cropping.
